purpose: Prove reduction compiles to native aggregation and that unknown multi-source composition fails closed instead of matching artifact producers.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util,json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/goal_compiler.py')
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('gc',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
reg=json.loads(pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/BOUND_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_V1.json').read_text())['capabilities']
goal=json.loads(pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime/missions/ASTRA_RUNTIME_MULTI_SOURCE_REDUCE_002.json').read_text())['goal']
out=m.compile_goal(goal,reg,pathlib.Path('.').resolve())
assert out['compiler_mode']=='DETERMINISTIC_MULTI_SOURCE_REDUCE_PLAN',out
assert out.get('clause_coverage_verified') is True,out
types=[a.get('type') for a in out['controller_actions']]
assert types==['invoke_capability','invoke_capability','aggregate_runtime_json_arrays','invoke_capability','assert_runtime_json_aggregate','invoke_capability','finish'],types
part=out['compiled_parts'][2]
assert part['mode']=='NATIVE_RUNTIME_GROUP_REDUCE',part
assert part['output_path']=='canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/USER_POST_COUNTS.json',part
assert out['controller_actions'][2]['args']['copy_fields']==['username'],out['controller_actions'][2]
print('MULTI_SOURCE_REDUCE_COMPILER_VERIFIED')
PY
